name: hub-no-spawn-area
description: Item 3 (user 2026-11-06: same as the workbench, just set this range): the Troll Hub carries a copy of the workbench's PlayerBase effect area with NoSpawnRadius (50 m) measured from the hub's OUTER edge (D-214, user 2026-11-10: 15.5 m from its middle), so the sphere is 65.5 m around the middle and no wild creature spawns near it. The hub stands 25 m ahead of the player; a point 45 m and one 60 m behind it (inside 65.5 m, the 60 m one only because of the extra edge) are inside the base area, a point 70 m behind it is outside.
